## Exploring Sample Means in R

Adjust the sample size $n$ below and watch how the sampling distribution of the mean narrows (Central Limit Theorem):

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
viewof sample_n = Inputs.range([2, 100], {
  value: 15,
  step: 1,
  label: "Sample size (n):"
})
```

```{webr}
#| input:
#|   - sample_n
set.seed(42)
means <- replicate(500, mean(rexp(sample_n, rate = 1)))

hist(
  means,
  breaks = 25,
  col = "#4e79a7",
  border = "white",
  xlim = c(0, 3),
  main = paste("Distribution of 500 Sample Means (n =", sample_n, ")"),
  xlab = "Sample Mean"
)
abline(v = 1, col = "#e15759", lwd = 2, lty = 2)
```
